resources.resource: Winning first-delivery carrier and authorized volatile User view

resources.purpose: Show once after confirmed commit; permit one explicit local download only from that same authorized held payload.

resources.resource: Explicit User-requested local download and exact owned QA transfer file
resources.store: User-controlled local browser download outside authoritative PostgreSQL; protected QA uses only its exact admitted owned file
logical_fields: Transient object URL/stream and exact owned transfer identity
resources.purpose: Fulfil the approved optional single local request from the current held view; privately verify and remove the exact admitted QA file.
resources.recipients: The requesting User. No provider upload, automatic download or new server archive/export recipient is introduced.
resources.implemented_lifecycle: App object URLs/streams and exact owned QA files require bounded disposal/removal. The server cannot prove that a user saved, later erased or never copied a local file. QA/container teardown is not domain retention/purge evidence.
resources.protection: Exact admission/path identity and private bounded byte checks; no transfer contents, fingerprints, raw errors or broad filesystem inspection in evidence.

retention_boundary: Credential validity, set retirement, operation expiry, disposable fixture cleanup and physical policy-bound deletion are distinct. No retention period, legal basis, default purge, archive relocation or production processing authority is selected.

governed_followup.implementation_owner: Identity implements bounded owner discovery, retention eligibility/actions, hold enforcement, deletion/anonymization and restore/reconciliation in the active owner scope, or governed RV lineage if that scope has closed.
governed_followup.approved_inputs_owner: TUN-P2-019 supplies approved scoped processing and trigger/action/hold/restore inputs; it does not implement the cleanup handlers.
governed_followup.timing: Implement and actually verify the applicable lifecycle controls before production activation and corresponding privacy/conformance acceptance. Independent authorized local primitive development is not blocked.

next_action: Execute the registered Identity-owned lifecycle follow-up with P2-019 approved inputs and P2-017 integration/proof before activation; preserve safe original lineage and all applicable holds.
